product_one_liner.value: Eden provides a cloud-based diagnostic operating system and AI tools that help health systems, hospitals, imaging centers and radiologists manage imaging workflows and generate diagnostic reports.

pricing_page.notes: A publicly accessible legacy Eva PACS registration page lists study-volume plans and monthly prices; it is not a current Eden-branded pricing page.

employee_band.notes: The company profile explicitly lists this size band; its separate employee figure is inconsistent, and the YC profile reports a team size of 100.

hq_location.notes: Current company profile lists Palo Alto; older funding coverage and some directories identify Mexico City.

eng_blog.notes: The index consists of product guides, releases and marketing/clinical articles; the CTO-featured AI and AWS articles do not establish two engineer-authored posts about product architecture or implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public API documentation includes sections for orders, examinations, appointments, budgets and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live listing: Member of Technical Staff, AI Research – Radiology Foundation Model.

model_provider.notes: Eden describes its own language-intelligence model for diagnostic conclusions. This does not establish an external foundation-model provider; AWS references describe infrastructure, not a named model.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO 27001 is explicitly described as a maintained certification; HIPAA is publicly displayed as a compliance claim. GDPR is discussed as applicable law, not a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The $22 million round was announced October 10, 2025, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The accessible current board lists an AI research role and no qualifying sales titles. Older social recruiting posts were not verified as still-open vacancies.

launched_6mo.notes: Eden announced Cortex on October 14, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Felipe Kitamura announced joining as Chief Medical Officer on March 2, 2026, within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A July 24, 2024 BDR recruiting post requires HubSpot experience; this is a historical stack signal, not confirmation of present usage.
